== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 2)]], showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-darkwaters&kraytdragonbones-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E1 text; the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-32-Dark_Waters_Krayt_Dragon_Bones.png]]) the original.

* '''Text source:''' the PC website card list (by 21 July 2012; the ▼ it dropped is drawn as on the slips). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on Rancor Pit. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. During your battle phase, if you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_33</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
